# Audit

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** api  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

An append-only record of who changed what. Ids and permission codes only — never a name, never PHI.

## Features

- Structured before/after diff of the changed fields
- Actor, organization, branch, action and target on every row
- Written inside the same transaction as the change it records

## Known limitations

- No viewer — rows are only readable via SQL
- `data_access_logs` for PHI reads is planned but does not exist
- Nothing enforces append-only at the database level; it is a convention
